Please check it before you keep it:
- Magic Hour doesn't have a simple tool to place photos side by side. I had to use its AI image editor (free-plan flux-2-klein, 640px, 5 credits), and I told it not to change either photo.
- Even with that instruction, the AI redraws the whole picture. Small details like the items on the old counter, the cabinet handles or the tile lines may look a little different from your originals. The labels might also come out imperfect.
- I couldn't preview the result on my end, so I haven't seen it myself.
- The output is 640px wide, so it's smaller than your photos.

If anything looks off, I can try again with a different free model. If you want your exact original photos with no changes at all, a basic collage app (or even PowerPoint or Canva) will do that perfectly.

It's a big change from that old wooden kitchen to the bright white cabinets and butcher-block counters. I hope it's nice to look back on.
